title: CDI Validation Specialist
description:
Overview

Position: CDI Validation Specialist

The CDI Validation Specialist assists the CDI Manager with oversight, evaluation, and analysis of CDI functions including efficiency, accuracy, continuing education needs, and overall quality. This individual identifies individual education needs of Clinical Documentation Specialists and collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to develop appropriate training materials. The primary goal is to ensure the documentation in the chart identifies all clinical findings, diagnoses and procedures and is appropriately and clinically supported. The CDI Validation Specialist will work with the CDI Manager to leverage performance, providing feedback and influence to continually improve documentation results thereby impacting key performance indicators.

Department: Clinical Documentation

Schedule: Full Time

Responsibilities

  • Monitors CDI staff accuracy, data quality and integrity.
  • Monitors CDS review process for content, timeliness and accurate diagnosis and procedure assignment in determining a working DRG.
  • Monitors concurrent queries for compliancy, accuracy, clarity, and timeliness.
  • Audits clinical documentation specialists retrospectively to assess for completeness of chart review and query compliance including missed query opportunities, accurate coding, and adherence to AHIMA/ACDIS compliant query guidelines/standards.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to identify, coordinate, and implement CDI specialist ongoing education and feedback based on identified opportunities for improvement via auditing.
  • Assists in orientation and training of new clinical documentation specialists
  • Reviews and analyzes denial claims and denial data to provide support in denial prevention strategies via clinical validation query process and education to CDI specialists.
  • Contributes to departmental and organizational quality performance goals, including auditing mortality and readmission cohorts to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate and implement CDI specialist education based on identified opportunities.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to create and update documentation tools, processes, procedures, and work flows on an ongoing and as needed basis.
  • Reviews charts concurrently with no MCC/CCs, low SOI/ROMs and LOS not supported by working DRG.
  • Identifies and educates CDI with missed query opportunities.
  • Assists CDI manager with final DRG validation when there is a discrepancy between CDS and coder.
  • Collaborates with the CDI Manager and identifies opportunities for performance improvement activities on processes.
  • Collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to strategize appropriate training methodology for individual issues.
  • Provides timely appropriate feedback to CDI Manager on any performance improvement plans for CDI staff.
  • Collaborates with other CDCI department managers to identify areas for improvement and solutions for process improvement.
  • Assures documentation is compliant with federal and state regulations, coding guidelines and hospital policies.
  • Remains up-to-date in clinical and coding/documentation-related materials, including CDS best practices as defined by ACDIS as well as ICD-10-CM/PCS, AHA Coding Clinic guidelines for coding and reporting and MS-DRG/APR-DRG classification systems.
  • Monitors regulatory and reimbursement changes.
  • Serves as resource for CDI informational needs and updates CDI on coding changes, medical science and CDI practice standards.
  • Provides guidance, support and expertise to the CDI specialists
  • Track trends in documentation concerns and implementing solutions for improvement.
  • Uses leadership and critical thinking skills to identify opportunities for team processes and engagement
  • Recommend solutions for improvement when deficiencies are identified.
  • Provides CDI specialists, coders, and coding validation specialists with clinical feedback to assist in accurately capture diagnoses and/or opportunities for querying physicians post discharge for additional information.
  • Evaluates the success of concurrent documentation improvement on an ongoing basis.
  • Advances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs and workshops and maintaining knowledge of industry standards and practices.
  • Assists manager, when requested, in the development of APR/DRG/query response physician reports. Maintains complete confidentiality of patient information in addition to hospital and individual physician practice pattern data.
  • Assumes operational oversight of CDI department in the absence of the CDI manager.
  • Adheres to all BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Note: The above statements depict the general nature and level of work assigned and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties and responsibilities.

Job Requirements

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in nursing, health information management or related field and at least five years (5) years experience in clinical documentation, or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master's degree

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required

  • Licensed RN

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Preferred

  • CCDS, CDIP

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs)

  • Demonstrate advanced knowledge of clinical documentation integrity practices, policies, workflows, and analysis.
  • Critical thinking, analytical and problem solving skills
  • Highly organized with strong project/task management skills
  • Knowledge of federal, state and payer specific regulations, policies and guidelines pertaining to coding (inpatient or outpatient), documentation requirements and billing
  • Experience with 3M Encoder/Grouper, SMART software preferred
  • Knowledge of care delivery documentation systems and related medical record documents.
  • Knowledge of age-specific needs and the elements of disease processes and related procedures.
  • Strong broad-based clinical knowledge and understanding of pathology/physiology of disease processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent critical thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated employee and medical staff relationships in the past and has the ability to maintain those going forward.
  • Working knowledge of inpatient admission criteria.
  • Ability to work independently in a time-oriented environment.
  • Computer literacy and familiarity with the operation of basic office equipment.
  • Assertive personality traits to facilitate ongoing physician communication.
  • Ability to be adapt to changes in the workload, to work independently and effectively prioritize work assignments
  • Working knowledge of Medicare reimbursement system and coding structures preferred, but not required.
  • Familiarity with physician practices, health information, case management or related healthcare discipline
  • Familiarity with all government health care reimbursement systems
  • Have experience working collaboratively with diverse groups in a health care environment
  • Demonstrated success in interacting effectively with physicians
  • Excellent speaking, writing and teaching skills
  • Proficient with standard Microsoft programs (i.e. MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and web browsers.
  • Ability to analyze large amounts of data to identify trends.
  • Ability to provide direction and development to employees by coaching, identifying training needs, assigning progressively challenging projects, and assisting in career development planning.

Overview

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

Job Overview: As a Senior Project Manager at Rocket Software, you will lead the delivery of primarily complex mainframe modernization projects for Rocket’s full product suite, typically ranging from $500k to $2M in services revenue, and occasionally overseeing more complex transitions or transformations valued up to $10M. In this role, you will coordinate multi-function, multi-vendor project teams—often spanning multiple regions—to meet aggressive but achievable deadlines while driving meaningful customer outcomes.

A strong technical background in one or more focus areas—such as infrastructure modernization, application modernization, process modernization, hybrid cloud deployments, microservices architecture, or enterprise-wide DevOps—is key. You’ll leverage this expertise to define project objectives, outline detailed delivery plans, and ensure alignment with customers business goals. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will collaborate with diverse stakeholders, including consultants, software engineers, end users, sales teams, and senior leadership, while maintaining transparency, accountability, and clear communication.

As part of the Rocket team, you will embrace and exemplify our core values of Empathy, Humanity, Trust, and Love, ensuring a customer-centric approach in every interaction. You’ll partner with colleagues to continually refine best practices and methodologies, promoting a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Ultimately, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-value solutions and exceptional experiences that help customers modernize their technology landscapes and achieve strategic success.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery Excellence & Customer Experience

  • Oversee the entire project lifecycle for large, high-risk, and often multi-region initiatives—managing timelines, deliverables, and quality standards to meet aggressive yet achievable deadlines.
  • Define and document clear project scope and objectives, preventing scope creep by continuously aligning all stakeholders with the project’s goals and deliverables.
  • Utilize Rocket’s project management framework to optimize workflows, accelerate time to value, and ensure customer-centric outcomes.
  • Coordinate requirement-gathering sessions, project kickoff meetings, status updates, and review meetings, maintaining transparency and alignment between internal teams and external clients.
  • Act as the primary interface with customers, forging trust-based relationships grounded in Rocket’s core values of Empathy, Humanity, Trust, and Love.
  • Monitor project risks and proactively address any challenges, conflicts, or schedule deviations to maintain project momentum and a positive customer experience.

Revenue Optimization & Portfolio Management

  • Collaborate with internal and customer stakeholders to match project resources, schedules, and financial parameters with contractual requirements.
  • Maintain transparent communication to set clear expectations around timelines, scope, and any potential risks affecting delivery or cost.
  • Provide reliable financial forecasts to management, adjusting as necessary based on evolving project scopes and timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales to proactively identify and pursue additional revenue opportunities, particularly for complex, high-risk engagements, by leveraging on-the-ground insights during project delivery to align emerging customer needs with Rocket’s broader solutions portfolio.
  • Lead or support early qualification and opportunity assessment for significant modernization projects, ensuring alignment with Rocket’s strategic objectives.
  • Maintain a well-rounded portfolio of customer engagements, balancing priorities and resource allocations to maximize both revenue potential and customer satisfaction.

Operational Excellence & Process Transformation

  • Implement and continuously improve standardized policies, procedures, and best practices that support consistent, high-quality project delivery.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and analyze project data to identify trends, address inefficiencies, and enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making, refine delivery approaches, and recommend process optimizations that reduce complexity, cost, and time-to-market.
  • Establish clear governance structures and reporting processes, providing stakeholders with real-time visibility into project progress, financial health, and risk status.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reinforce Rocket’s commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and delivering transformative customer outcomes.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach project managers to enhance their leadership and delivery capabilities.
  • Guide project managers in handling customer escalations with a problem-solving mindset, ensuring resolutions align with Rocket’s values and maintain strong customer trust.
  • Develop and implement career development plans for team members.
  • Drive a culture of continuous learning, fostering knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Implement coaching frameworks to support exceptional customer experiences and project outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Account Executives during project delivery to keep them informed on progress, collaborate on customer challenges, and seek their support in resolving key issues.
  • Collaborate with Product Development to align project execution with the product roadmap.
  • Work closely with Customer Success Management, Product Engineering, and Delivery Engineering to ensure seamless customer engagements.
  • Facilitate communication between technical and business stakeholders, driving alignment on project goals and priorities.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Project management certification preferred (e.g., PMP, PgMP).
  • Additional certifications in Agile methodologies are beneficial.

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive project management experience, preferably with enterprise-scale portfolios in a professional services organization of a software company (or equivalent related experience).
  • 6+ years leading senior-level customer-facing project managers in a strategic or operational leadership role.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and business transformation through project delivery in a software, SaaS, or enterprise software environment.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration within SaaS companies, enterprise software organizations, or consulting environments, working across teams to align project goals and ensure successful delivery.

Skills & Competencies

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Executive-level communication skills.
  • Advanced coaching and mentoring abilities.
  • Transformational leadership with a focus on operational excellence.
  • Expertise in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.

Project Delivery and Strategy

  • Resource optimization and portfolio management.
  • Advanced project planning and risk management.
  • Process improvement and change management expertise.
  • Focus on accelerating time-to-value through efficient delivery.

Financial and Operational Acumen

  • Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles.
  • Experience in financial management, budgeting, and performance monitoring.
  • Ability to analyze and address complex operational challenges.

Collaboration Network

  • CSE Delivery Management
  • Sales and Pre-Sales teams
  • Support & Product Development
  • Customer Success
  • Customer stakeholders

Communication Requirements

  • Maintain regular communication with the CSE PMO management team, cross-functional teams, and Functional Leadership.

title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Overview

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Qualifications

  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a 'no' as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.
  • Extent & Duration: Start ASAP.

Employment Details

Full time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

Location and Compensation

Location: You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice. Economy: Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

Next Steps

Please send your English CV to: ******. Please state the application code TEL2025HH in the subject of your email.

description:
Overview

Company Description

Highlights of this position:

  • Location: Remote – Brazil (must be located in Brazil)
  • Mandatory : English Fluency, Delphi, Oracle and Agile/Scrum.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

Job Description

In the role, you will work with a dedicated, enthusiastic team developing enhancements to a Laboratory Information Management System (a LIMS) and supporting the LIMS' multiple customers.

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Location : Brazil

How can you help us?

As a Delphi Developer, you will actively interact with Product Owners and other stakeholders to:

  • Estimate the complexity and the workload
  • Choose the most appropriate technical solution to meet the user requirements
  • Design, develop and deploy changes to the LIMS according to the customers’ and business users’ requirements.
  • Support the LIMS in collaboration with the other team members
  • Working together with other team members (Engineers/QA) to ensure high quality of delivered solutions.
  • Ensuring good practices and high quality standards are implemented and followed.

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

  • 4+ years of experience developing solutions using Embarcadero Delphi 2006 or later (Delphi 12 preferable)
    • Experience with using Delphi to develop Windows Services and/or UI Forms would be a clear bonus
  • 4+ years of experience with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong working knowledge on server-side development with Delphi and/or with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Good understanding of relational databases (Oracle 9i, 11c or later)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile software development practices, particularly Scrum and/or Kanban
  • Clear experience in collaboration with Business Analysts and Software Architect(s)
  • Some Experience in test driven development and test automation
  • Comfortable in unit testing and mocking with Delphi
  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical solutions.

Education

  • Bachelor 2s or master a0s degree in computer Science or similar;

What else should I know?

As the role and Eurofins' IT Talent Acquisition team are international, please ensure to submit your application in English.

Working hours

Monday to Friday - 8:00 to 17:00

Additional Information

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

  • Gympass | Acesso a academias de todo o país
  • Caju - cartão flexível bandeira Visa
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica Sulamérica
  • Desconto em todos os produtos nos app: Dafiti

Confira o que é moda por aqui e se candidate!

Somos a Dafiti, a maior fashiontech da América Latina. Desde 2011, transformamos a forma como as pessoas consomem moda, unindo tecnologia, inovação e paixão pelo que fazemos. Nossa história começou quando Philipp Povel e Malte Huffmann - criadores do e-commerce MyBrands na Alemanha - se uniram a Malte Horeyseck e Thibaud Lecuyer para revolucionar o mercado brasileiro. No ano seguinte, ampliamos nosso impacto com a abertura da Dafiti na Colômbia. Hoje, fazemos parte do Global Fashion Group (GFG) , líder global em moda online em mercados de alto crescimento, o que potencializa ainda mais nossa atuação e nos conecta a tendências e inovações do mundo inteiro.

No Brasil, contamos com mais de 4 milhões de clientes ativos , oferecendo uma plataforma com mais de 3 mil marcas e mais de 400 mil produtos . Para garantir a melhor experiência, temos o maior centro de distribuição de moda online da América Latina e a maior solução AutoStore do mundo, o Leap, localizado em Extrema-MG.

Somos mais de 1.000 Dafiters , movidos pelo propósito de inspirar as pessoas a se divertirem com a moda. Acreditamos no “sim”: sim para marcas exclusivas, sim para entregas em qualquer lugar, sim para inovação e, principalmente, sim para a diversão! Nossa missão é levar a moda do mundo para todo mundo, tornando-a acessível, democrática e transformadora.

Aqui, valorizamos a diversidade, o trabalho em equipe e a criação de um ambiente acolhedor , onde todos se sintam motivados a entregar o melhor para nossos clientes. Nossa cultura é vibrante, colaborativa e apaixonada pelo negócio. E não esquecemos da nossa responsabilidade social e ambiental. Acreditamos que a moda tem o poder de mudar o mundo e, por isso, buscamos sempre práticas sustentáveis e ações que impactem positivamente a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de um time inovador, apaixonado e que acredita no poder transformador da moda, seu lugar é aqui. Confira nossas oportunidades e venha construir o futuro da moda com a gente!

title: Director, Modern Data Solutions
description:
Overview

What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

The Director, Modern Data Solutions plays an essential role guiding internal teams and clients with best practices on handling modern data types. The rapid evolution of workspace collaboration tools and cloud-based documents has exponentially expanded the data sources required for eDiscovery collection, processing, review, and production. Working closely with clients, sales and delivery teams, this role ensures the client’s goals for a matter are met when modern data types are involved across the end to end matter lifecycle. Tapping into their extensive expertise on modern data types and trends, the Director, Modern Data Solutions serves as a guide and coach to internal teams as they further their knowledge of emerging data types and new workflows. Leveraging both LH and third party technologies, this role also collaborates with product managers (PdM) to define and optimize the end-to-end workflow, service capabilities, technologies for scalable solutions for LH clients.

What will this person do?

  • Operationalize and manage implementation of new solutions for modern data types. Partner with SMEs, documentation teams and enablement team to define and / or optimize workflows for clients with live matters. Ensure workflows are documented and understood by the teams supporting the data type.
  • Serve as an expert on handling modern data – staying on top of trends with Microsoft 365, Google/Gvault, etc, engaging product teams at OEMs, etc. Raise client and data trends with product team to evaluate and consider including in the solution roadmap. Continuously monitor and evaluate effectiveness of standard offerings to identify opportunities to improve solution set
  • Lead Data workflow council to drive decisions on workflows, treatment of data across cross functional teams (Innovations solutions, processing/operations, product, digital forensics, advisory, UK, etc). Partner with forensics & operations teams to rapidly respond to incoming data and determine best workflow to employ
  • Drives communication and education of relevant teams on new data type solutions and corresponding workflows across Spectra, RelOne and full services - encompassing the full LH platform
  • Acting as the voice of the customer for services, provide analysis with data when possible that backs a consolidated viewpoint and partner with product teams to influence the product pipeline, long term roadmap and help shape LH’s future solutions. Conduct initial analysis, fact finding and facilitate feedback loop back to product on input and optimizations from delivery.
  • Assess workflow/ support model impacts to influence design of the technology; assess viability and potential risks to the solution
  • Evaluation of 3rd party technology as part of the long term technology vision for new data types would be the responsibility of the product development organization
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus)
  • 10+ years of e-discovery experience, with 5+ years of e-discovery project management, operations or consulting experience
  • Experience in product management a plus
  • Strong analytical and problemsolving skills
  • Deep understanding of e-discovery best practices and of current and emerging technologies including: computer forensics, data collection, modern data/messaging platform administration (M365, Teams, Slack, Google), third-party tools for data collection, exporting and/or processing (Cellebrite, MessageCrawler, Encase, Onna, Logikcull), litigation support, Nuix, Relativity.
  • Role should have technical depth equivalent to a product manager. Primary skill needed is deep understanding of EDRM data uses, formats, fields and potential downstream nuances. Important to understand how to interact with the product teams and roles – the ideal candidate would have product experience but not necessary.
  • Ability to interpret complex technical requirements
  • Ability to foster positive and professional relationships at all levels internally and externally and to leverage those relationships to effectively drive projects to completion
  • Ability to solve complex problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where only limited standards exist
  • Effective written and oral communication skills, including the ability to deal with difficult situations and manage conflicts to successful resolution
  • Outstanding organizational skills and the ability to multitask
  • Navigate a global, matrix-organization and ability to maintain positive, authentic relationships

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table
  • Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting
  • Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends)

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!

As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.

The expected pay for this role will range from $ 150,000 to $170,000 per year. This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.

Lighthouse offers a quality comprehensive benefits package including, medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match. Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine through 98point6, and other wellness plans. We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days. Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.

As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.

A SEGULA Technologies é um grupo de engenharia com presença global que atende à necessidade de todos os principais setores industriais: automotivo, aeroespacial, energia, ferroviário, naval, farmacêutico e petroquímico.

Uma empresa líder em engenharia que coloca a inovação no centro de sua estratégia, a SEGULA Technologies realiza projetos de grande escala, desde a pesquisa até a industrialização e a produção.

Encorajamos candidatos de diversos backgrounds, incluindo, mas não se limitando a raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência e religião, a se candidatarem.

Descrição do emprego

Buscamos um Especialista de Projetos para desenvolver as seguintes atividades:

  • Colaborar com as equipes CTPC/PCP, SLCP e CMTD responsáveis pelo Livro de Custos Global para estabelecer claramente os requisitos, definir o escopo do projeto e determinar cronogramas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os departamentos de Engenharia de Custos, Compras, Finanças, Logística e TIC para estabelecer requisitos de integração.
  • Supervisionar o processo de estudo dos requisitos do projeto para definir os objetivos, o escopo e o cronograma do projeto.
  • Auxiliar com requisição de compra, ordem de compra e processos de contrato, conforme necessário.
  • Coordenar com o gerente de projetos de TIC para lidar com especificações, design de arquitetura, revisões técnicas, integração, aceitação do usuário, testes de sistema e implementação de soluções em todas as regiões do cliente.
  • Supervisionar e coordenar as atividades da equipe do projeto.
  • Comunicar a visão do negócio à equipe de implementação, explique claramente os objetivos do projeto e facilitar as discussões da equipe para avanços.
  • Garantir a conformidade com os padrões e diretrizes de TIC do cliente.
  • Acompanhe o roteiro, o orçamento, os riscos e os recursos do projeto e relataras atualizações em reuniões regulares de status e do comitê de direção.
  • Responsável pela aprovação da História do Usuário e pela participação nos critérios de entrada e saída das fases.
  • Coordenar e liderar as fases de testes de UAT, carga e não regressão com a equipe de negócios.
  • Servir como principal elo de comunicação com todas as partes interessadas.
  • Esta função abrange todas as fases do estudo, design, desenvolvimento, teste, implantação e suporte pós-lançamento.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em engenharia, ciência da computação ou área correlata.
  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos de TI.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos do início à conclusão.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas e processos de gestão de custos de veículos automotivos.
  • Experiência com integração de software, incluindo sistemas e ferramentas legados.
  • Proficiência em comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês, com capacidade de explicar conceitos complexos com clareza.

title: Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program
description:
Overview

This is an international staff role based at our Headquarters in Washington, D.C. We offer visa and relocation support.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

The Amazonia Forever Unit has rapidly positioned itself as a strategic leader in advancing sustainable development across the Amazonia region. In just three years, it has mobilized over $4.2 billion in operations across eight countries, launched innovative financing mechanisms, including Indigenous-led funds. Coordinated the first loans under the Green Climate Fund and the Amazon Bioeconomy and Forest Management Fund. Through regional networks, knowledge platforms, and global partnerships, the Unit has strengthened institutional capacities, promoted inclusive growth, and elevated the IDB’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.

We are seeking a strategic leader to serve as Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program. This role is central to advancing sustainable and inclusive development across the Amazonia region, which is home to nearly 40% of South America’s landmass. The Unit Chief will lead cross-sectoral efforts, manage funding mechanisms, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure impactful and cohesive development strategies.

This position will report to the Manager of the Southern Cone Department. It will advise and support the Vice Presidency of Countries and Regional Integration, as well as the CSC, CAN, and CCB Managers, in the preparation, development, and implementation of national and regional dialogues, strategies, and activities related to the Amazonia Forever Program.

What you’ll do

As Unit Chief, you will lead and manage the Amazonia Forever Regional Program within the Bank and its funding mechanisms and coordinate the external partners and networks that are part of the Program.

Regional Dialogues & Country Engagement

  • Coordinate high-level dialogues across Amazonia-region countries, in close collaboration with Country Representatives, to identify shared priorities and build consensus around strategic development goals.
  • Align Amazonia Forever Program goals with Country Strategies, ensuring coherence across sectors and countries.
  • Engage diverse partners and stakeholders to shape initiatives within the Amazonia Forever Program.

Operational Strategy & Policy Development

  • Advise senior management on the formulation of operational strategies, policies, and guidelines tailored to the Amazonia region.
  • Promote implementation of the program’s five key pillars:
  • Combating deforestation and strengthening environmental control and security.
  • Bioeconomy and creative economy.
  • People-centered development.
  • Sustainable cities, infrastructure, and connectivity.
  • Sustainable, low-carbon agriculture, livestock, and forestry.
  • Integrate cross-cutting themes: inclusion of women, Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and local communities; climate, biodiversity, and forest conservation; and institutional capacity and rule of law.

Financing And Resource Mobilization

  • Collaborate with the IDB Global Partnerships Department to mobilize resources from donors and partners.
  • Coordinate and manage various funding mechanisms, including donor resources and IDB’s own funds.
  • Leverage Amazonia Forever’s financial instruments to support strategic solutions for regional development challenges.

Stakeholder Engagement & Community Dialogues

  • Coordinate inclusive engagement with civil society, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, and traditional Amazonian populations in collaboration with IDB Civil Society Unit.
  • Strengthening partnerships with national and international organizations, donors, and private sector actors.

Knowledge & Innovation Agenda

  • Lead the knowledge and innovation agenda of the Amazonia Forever Program, working in close coordination with the Southern Cone, Andean, and Caribbean Departments to ensure regional integration and strategic alignment.
  • Promote experimental programs and pioneering research to support sustainable development.
  • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products aligned with program priorities.

Institutional Partnerships & External Representation

  • Coordinate joint initiatives with IDB Invest and IDB Lab.
  • Ensure integration of cross-cutting themes such as climate resilience, sustainability, and social inclusion within IDB Group.
  • Represent the IDB in global forums and multilateral platforms to promote the Bank’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with other MDBs, international agencies, and private sector actors to support coordinated regional efforts.

What you'll need

  • Education: You hold an advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) from an accredited university in a field of the social sciences or humanities that is relevant to sustainable and inclusive development.
  • Experience: Experience related to advancing sustainable and/or inclusive development in the region.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English, and Spanish or Portuguese.

Professional Experience

  • You have extensive experience conducting strategic-level technical dialogues with diverse groups (e.g. public sector, private sector, civil society, Indigenous and/or traditional communities), including dialogues in matters related to your work.
  • Experience facilitating dialogues and negotiations that directly involved more than one country is a plus.
  • You have experience in connecting strategic-level discussions with realities at the operational level.
  • A working understanding of multi-lateral development banks is advantageous.
  • You have demonstrated understanding of the fundamental economic, socio-cultural, and environmental characteristics of the Amazonian territories within the countries that are the focus of the Amazonia Forever Regional Program.

Requirements

  • Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Staff: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: a defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and supports employees in planning for their future.
  • We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center, which provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

title: Medical Director
description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

The Medical Director is a medical spokesperson for Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield with the provider network across NJ. The Medical Director will be accountable for providing leadership, direction and daily support for their assigned region of NJ and assigned providers; the scope of activities include, but are not limited to, utilization management, care management, disease management, quality management, pharmacy management, post service reviews, provider education, support for provider relations issues, and clinical transformation. The Medical Director is accountable for a personal caseload of daily medical management activities and contributing to operational effectiveness of the medical management program.
Medical Policy and HPIRIT only:
The position has primary responsibility for the medical review for the Clinical Inquiries Team (CIT) and support special investigations unit as needed. Also, the position supports the development and implementation of reimbursement policies.

Responsibilities:

  • Support all lines of business which includes Commercial and Government Programs.

  • Collaborate with value based teams, Behavioral Health and Pharmacy; supports accounts and activities for cross functional areas by region, where applicable. Supports sales teams as assigned by region.

  • Guides, supports and consults with nurse reviewers on pre-authorization, concurrent and retrospective review issues, post-service reviews, pre-determinations and decisions, where applicable. Consult with/support case management to determine best course for members, assist with PG and address issues.

  • Develops and maintains effective collaborative relationships with providers in assigned geographic areas. This includes on site or virtual review of performance and coaching activities with physicians, hospitals and ancillary providers.

  • May provide input into provider credentialing, profiling and communication initiatives.

  • Responsible for data analysis on case management and utilization, identify issues and escalate as necessary to senior management.

  • Interprets and analyzes available utilization, cost and quality reports and develops steps to address variances to target performance matrix. Collaborates on documentation of monthly reporting address performance, issues and activities for assigned region.

  • Assists with assessment of network capabilities by region and collaborates with network management, contracting and value based teams in addressing network gaps.

  • Creates/participates in internal or external educational activities for other members of the team/stakeholders across regional/functional areas.

  • Participates in Committee activities as assigned.

  • Assist with coverage across functional MD teams, as needed, including participation in calls for all areas.

  • Support medical policy development process, review medical and pharmacy policies and provide feedback regarding utilization to the development team.

  • Works with legal and mandate team to support Horizon’s compliance with the NJ Department of banking and insurance (DOBI).

  • Backup chair for committees with internal and external stakeholders.

Medical Policy and HPIRIT only:

  • Performs medical reviews for the Clinical Inquiries Team (CIT) and support special investigations unit as needed.

  • Support development and implementation of reimbursement policies.

  • Assist with coverage across functional MD teams as needed including participation in calls for all areas.

Functional Competencies:

  • Knowledge in the principles of Utilization Management, Case Management, Quality Management and accreditation/regulatory standards.

  • Requires broad clinical knowledge and understanding of current health care issues and climate.

  • Requires some knowledge of health insurance payer business including business operations.

Education/Experience:

  • Requires Board Certification in an American Board of Medicine recognized specialty Requires current unrestricted MD or DO license to practice medicine.

  • Requires 5-7 years Clinical Experience Experience with managing data to identify key issues, developing recommendations and providing content/conclusions to executive management.

  • Proficiency working with Tableau or similar software required.

  • Proficiency also required working with a Windows based environment including MS Office products.

  • Continuous Improvement Experience Preferred.

Specific to Medical Policy:

  • Ability to review studies, understand evidence based medicine and support medical policy development.

  • Ability to chair committees with internal and external stakeholders.

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • Active Unrestricted MD or DO License Required; NJ License Required, No CMS Sanctions or sanctions by other regulatory agencies or boards.

  • Must be board certified by a specialty recognized by the American Osteopathic Association or the American Board of Medical Specialties.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Business Acumen: Identify key issues and opportunities, developing strategies and plans and have resolute decision making.

  • Planning and Organizing: Leveraging resources, staying focused and effectively prioritizing key objectives.

  • Building Strategic Working Relationships: Proactively tries to build effective working relationships; facilitates agreement; clarifies current situation; involving appropriate individuals within team and broader organization to achieve desired results.

  • Executive Presence: Advocates for the organization, inspiring confidence among peers regarding reliability and capability, inspiring senior leadership expectations on potential for outstanding outcomes and achievements.

  • Meeting Leadership: Ensures a meeting serves its business objectives; facilitating agreement; develops others' and own ideas; closes discussions with clear summaries.

  • Negotiation: Effectively exploring alternatives and positions to reach outcomes that gain the support and acceptance of all parties.

  • Matrix Environment: Ability to function and work in a matrix environment which includes working on and at time leading cross functional teams.

  • Conflict resolution: ability to identify conflict, determine its causes and negotiate mutually agreeable solutions.

Travel % (If Applicable):

  • The position requires access to a car and the ability to travel for meetings with physicians, hospitals and ancillary providers as required.

Horizon BCBSNJ employees must live in New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut or Delaware

Salary Range:

$211,000 - $293,475

This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. description:
Overview

SOBRE A CAPCO
Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia. Somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes e temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico. Se criatividade e inovação são a sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos à procura de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) altamente habilidoso e apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Como desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack , você terá um papel fundamental na criação e manutenção de sistemas robustos, escaláveis e eficientes que suportam nossos processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e integração de dados. Você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, incluindo Java e React.js, NoSQL (MongoDB), arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir que nosso sistema seja altamente observável e fácil de depurar.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs back end e front end que suportem os processos de ETL e integração de dados (Java e React.js).
  • Implementar soluções de armazenamento de dados NoSQL, como MongoDB, para armazenar e consultar dados de forma eficaz.
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de integração baseados em eventos para facilitar a comunicação entre os diferentes componentes do sistema.
  • Trabalhar com protocolos FTP e lidar com arquivos posicionais para a troca de dados com parceiros externos.
  • Garantir que o sistema de ETL seja altamente observável, permitindo a fácil depuração de problemas e a monitoração de desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos e garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam às necessidades de negócios.
  • Realizar testes de unidade, integração e aceitação para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada e participar na revisão de código.
  • Ficar atualizado com as melhores práticas e tendências em desenvolvimento back end e front end.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end e front end, em um ambiente de microserviços com Linguagem Java, Spring Boot, React.js.
  • Conhecimento sólido em NoSQL, com experiência prática em MongoDB.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas ETL.
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos FTP e manipulação de arquivos posicionais.
  • Habilidade de escrever código limpo, escalável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.
  • Inglês avançado (atuará em time internacional).

Por Que Capco

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. Pensamos, em conjunto, ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. Nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas para todos(as)!!!

title: Supervisor de Unidade
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

Fundado em Brasília pelas bioquímicas Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, o Grupo Sabin está há 38 anos no mercado. Somos referência em Medicina Diagnóstica, com atuação em análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, vacinação e check-up executivo. O Sabin também atua em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS) com a Amparo Saúde e lançou, no ano passado, a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde Rita Saúde. Somos reconhecidos no Brasil e na América Latina como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar há mais de 18 anos, com cultura organizacional forte, respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão. Contamos com mais de 6.700 colaboradores, em 12 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 323 unidades.

Responsibilities

  • Planejar e administrar o trabalho da equipe, definindo rotinas, técnicas de abordagem de clientes e estratégias para cumprir metas e prazos;
  • Supervisionar todas as rotinas administrativas da equipe;
  • Supervisionar serviços gerais de malotes, mensageiros, transporte, limpeza, terceirizados, manutenção de equipamento, mobiliário e instalações;
  • Responder pelas metas e resultados da equipe, traçando planos de avanço e de melhoria contínua;
  • Monitorar os indicadores da área;
  • Planejar e desenvolver novos projetos, quando aplicável;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento, informações e metas com toda a equipe;
  • Controlar as atividades financeiras das unidades;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes, mercado e médicos;
  • Realizar mapeamento de mercado local e fechar parcerias para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Gerenciar o clima organizacional, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo;
  • Promover feedbacks de forma respeitosa;
  • Sinalizar casos de baixa performance à gestão de pessoal;
  • Realizar desligamentos junto ao RH, quando aplicável;
  • Assegurar que as políticas e normas da empresa sejam cumpridas pela equipe;
  • Desenvolver novos лидеры quando aplicável;
  • Propor ações de melhoria contínua;

Qualifications

  • Graduação completa em Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas da Saúde;
  • Desejável especialização em Gestão em Saúde, Administração Hospitalar ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em Boas Práticas Laboratoriais, biossegurança e protocolos de qualidade;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em cargos de liderança em serviços de saúde;
  • Experiência na implementação de processos, protocolos de qualidade e auditorias;
  • Curso de Auditor PALC será um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado será considerado um diferencial;
  • Etapas do processo seletivo incluem entrevista com o gestor.

About Sabin

Referência em saúde, destacada pela gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, o Grupo Sabin nasceu em Brasília há décadas, fruto da coragem de duas empreendedoras. Hoje, conta com cerca de 7.000 colaboradores, presente em 14 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 354 unidades, oferecendo serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental. O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo, além de serviços de atenção primária com a Amparo Saúde e a plataforma Rita Saúde, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência. Em 2020, foi lançado o SkyHub.Bio, hub de inovação para promoção e desenvolvimento de startups na saúde. O Grupo mantém o Instituto Sabin, criado em 2005 para ações de impacto social, que já beneficiou mais de 1,6 milhão de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos e vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin pelo Brasil. Investimos em processos formulados para atrair pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

Fique atento e evite golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.

  • Supervisionar a produção de materiais gráficos, digitais e físicos (formulários, adesivos, folders, identificações de salas, entre outros);
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho de sites, redes sociais, ferramentas de marketing, eventos, ações, gastos do Deptº, campanhas e afins, avaliar os resultados e apresentar à Gestão, sugerindo melhorias, quando identificada a necessidade;

  • Elaborar o “Planejamento de Marketing” e supervisionar a execução das ações de campanhas planejadas, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e do orçamento anual;
  • Atuar junto aos demais Deptºs, para identificar problemas e oportunidades que o Deptº de Marketing poderá apoiar com soluções e inovações e desenvolver ações para as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Realizar visitas a clientes e parceiros da empresa, junto com Gestores e equipes do Deptº Comercial, para apoiar o processo de vendas, identificando oportunidades, traçando estratégias, ações e campanhas para inovação e soluções;
  • Assegurar o uso devido das marcas e a identidade visual da empresa dentro (formulários e materiais internos) e fora da empresa (material público e páginas institucionais);
  • Gerir pautas, horários, atribuir tarefas, supervisionar as atividades e desempenho da equipe de Marketing;
  • Desenvolver e implantar novos procedimentos do Deptº, treinar e capacitar a equipe em todas as etapas;
  • Fornecer informações sobre eventos e brindes, para o time de Compliance, a fim de que estes estejam em conformidade com o Código de Conduta, Políticas e normas diversas, estabelecidas pelo Deptº de Compliance.

Description

At ScionHealth , we empower our caregivers to do what they do best. We value every voice by caring deeply for every patient and each other. We show courage by running toward the challenge and we lean into new ideas by embracing curiosity and question asking. Together, we create our culture by living our values in our day-to-day interactions with our patients and teammates.

Job Summary

  • The Utilization Management Manager plays a vital role in ensuring patients have timely access to care by managing both front-end prior authorizations and in-house concurrent review authorizations. This position blends strong relationship-building skills with clinical knowledge to navigate complex payer requirements, streamline the authorization process, and support seamless patient transitions.
  • From start to finish, this role drives the authorization process—reviewing prospective, retrospective, and concurrent medical records; coordinating with referring hospitals to secure prior authorizations; and partnering with case management teams at ScionHealth facilities to complete concurrent review authorizations. Acting as a navigator and liaison between Business Development, facility administration, managed care organizations, and payors, the specialist ensures determinations are communicated promptly and accurately to all relevant stakeholders.
  • By combining attention to detail with proactive collaboration, the Utilization Management Manager safeguards revenue integrity, reduces delays, and supports the organization’s mission of delivering exceptional patient care. This role actively contributes to quality improvement, problem-solving, and productivity initiatives within an interdisciplinary model, demonstrating accountability and a commitment to operational excellence.

Essential Functions

  • Extrapolates and summarizes essential medical information to obtain authorization for admission and continued stay to/at ScionHealth Level of Care
  • Prepares recommendations to submit timely request for reconsideration of denial determination in attempt to have denied authorization requests overturned
  • Ensures authorization requests are processed timely to meet regulatory timeframes
  • Reviews medical necessity assessments completed by case management, evaluating documentation for specific criteria related to severity of illness, and level of care appropriateness

title: Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description:
Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to join the Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division of Crude Oil Sales & Marketing Dept (COSMD).

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and manage various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and long-term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consult directly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management.
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis to support the areas of commercializing low carbon crude oil and low carbon products such as LCAF, SAF, Naphtha and others with focus on offsetting and carbon markets mechanisms.
  • Prepare and present plans, analyses, interpretations, conclusions and recommendations to Management and others on a broad range of petroleum market issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognized and approved program.
  • Advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.
  • Over 12 years of experience in oil and gas sustainability, Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) and carbon market industry.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets and environmental regulations related to GHG Emissions with understanding of the compliance carbon markets, voluntary carbon markets, baseline and crediting mechanisms, carbon-related trade measures and carbon pricing.

A PUC angels (Associação Anjos da PUC) é uma associação sem fins lucrativos que busca, por meio da educação, aprimorar o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e empregabilidade no Brasil. Acreditamos que o primeiro empreendimento de uma pessoa é sua carreira profissional. Hoje, contamos com mais de 20 colaboradores diretos e uma rede de mais de 4.000 executivos e 1.000 estudantes no Programa Anjo, que também pode incluir você – com oportunidades para atuar como mentor, executivo, empreendedor e/ou investidor.

Comitês da PUC angels: Seu Espaço para Impacto e Crescimento

A PUC angels conta com diversos comitês focados em áreas estratégicas, cada um impulsionando a evolução e integração de seus respectivos mercados através do conhecimento e networking. Buscamos talentos para os seguintes comitês:

  • Comitê de Saúde
  • Comitê de Gestão de Pessoas
  • Comitê de Liderança Feminina
  • Comitê de Educação
  • Comitê de Fomento a Startups e Empreendedorismo
  • Comitê de Inteligência Artificial

Formato e Papéis: Membro Executivo vs. Líder Anjo do Comitê

O cargo é voluntário e remoto, e você poderá atuar como Membro Executivo do comitê de sua escolha (com possibilidade de progressão para Líder Anjo).

  • Como Membro Executivo: Você participa de reuniões gerais e abertas, eventos, pode sugerir temas e divulgar seu título no LinkedIn. Sua contribuição direta auxilia fundadores de startups, executivos e estudantes no desenvolvimento e aplicação de conhecimentos.
  • Como Líder Anjo: Além das atividades de Membro, você terá a oportunidade de liderar Comissões e Iniciativas, assumir diretorias, submeter temas para avaliação da Presidência do Comitê, e concorrer à liderança do Comitê. Também terá acesso a eventos exclusivos para Líderes Anjo e outros associados.

Qualificações:

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem:

  • Interesse e paixão pelos temas dos comitês da PUC angels.
  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e aplicar conhecimentos na prática.
  • Paixão por contribuir para a sociedade por meio da educação.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento.
  • Habilidade de trabalho remoto e proativo.
  • Envolvimento com o tema do comitê de interesse.
  • Proficiência em português (inglês e espanhol são diferenciais, dada a expansão da PUC angels).
  • Paciência e habilidade para ensinar e motivar.

Por que Participar como Membro ou Líder Anjo nos Comitês da PUC angels?

  • Ganhe visibilidade no mercado, destacando-se em sua área de atuação como um Líder Anjo de um Comitê da PUC angels.
  • Tenha impacto direto no ecossistema de inovação e nas mudanças de mercado, assumindo uma posição de liderança.
  • Acrescente experiência e o título de Membro Executivo / Líder Anjo do Comitê da PUC angels ao seu perfil profissional.
  • Expanda seu networking com mais de 4.000 executivos, 1.000 alunos e empreendedores.
  • Participe como mentor, conselheiro, investidor e/ou empreendedor dentro do ecossistema de networking da PUC angels.
  • Escolha as frentes em que deseja atuar ou explore todas as oportunidades que oferecemos.

Atividades e Oportunidades Complementares nos Comitês:

Você poderá se envolver em:

  • Reuniões online: Sessões periódicas sobre temas de mercado e painéis com profissionais de destaque.
  • Produção de artigos: Elaboração de conteúdos sobre novidades e dados de mercado.
  • Regulamentações: Participação em grupos para regulamentação de iniciativas, com interação direta com executivos, empresas, governo e outras associações via PUC angels.
  • Oportunidade de investir em projetos já existentes.
  • Sessões de pitch (online e presenciais), eventos de aceleração e parcerias estratégicas.
  • Atuação como Mentor ou Conselheiro Anjo para startups e estudantes.

Networking e Eventos:

  • Acesso a grupos exclusivos no WhatsApp e LinkedIn.
  • Participação em eventos temáticos presenciais e online promovidos pela PUC angels e seus Comitês, em locais de destaque como a Tuca da PUC SP, Inovabra e FIEP.

Missão e Objetivo:

A Missão da PUC angels é melhorar o mundo através da educação e do combate à fome. Nossos Comitês visam promover a evolução e integração dos mercados em que atuam através do conhecimento e networking, atuando, quando necessário, na regulamentação necessária para que cada mercado cresça de forma sustentável.

Se você se identifica com nossa missão e deseja fazer parte de um de nossos Comitês, cadastre-se aqui e nos diga qual área mais te interessa!

Atuando dentro da área de Business Transformation, esse papel conecta o suporte diário à missão maior da empresa, ajudando a transformar processos internos em experiências simples e eficazes para milhões de pessoas que acessam bem-estar todos os dias.

Como Analista de CX, você será responsável por fornecer uma experiência de atendimento de alta qualidade. Trabalhará para a resolução de problemas e atendimento consultivo de usuários, clientes e parceiros através de diversos canais. Sua missão é garantir a confiança do cliente com a nossa marca a partir de interações eficientes, empáticas e profissionais para promover satisfação e fidelidade.

Dentro da área de Atendimento ao Cliente do Wellhub, atuamos em Tribos com foco no perfil específico do cliente. Neste programa teremos posições dentro dos times de: Risk and Fraud , Partners Experience (New Ventures e Partners) , End Users Experience (End User, Reclame Aqui e Social Media)

  • CX Risk and Fraud (Prevention): Você atuará como um "escudo protetor" do ecossistema Wellhub. O foco será analisar dados para identificar e mitigar fraudes, além de se comunicar de forma empática em casos delicados. Você será fundamental para garantir a integridade e a confiança em todas as interações.
  • Foco do Suporte: Fornecer suporte a usuários, parceiros e clientes em vários canais.
  • Análise de Risco: Analisar dados para tomar decisões sobre usuários com potencial de fraude e reportar comportamentos suspeitos que possam causar perdas financeiras à Wellhub.
  • CX New Ventures: Sua principal função será dar suporte direto a parceiros, terapeutas, personal trainers e usuários finais. Você resolverá questões técnicas e complexas em diversos canais para assegurar uma experiência de alta qualidade.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com questões de parceiros e usuários finais, principalmente por e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Resolução de Problemas: Avaliar as necessidades dos clientes e escalar problemas para outros departamentos ou equipes técnicas quando necessário.
  • CX Partners: Neste papel, você dará suporte direto a parceiros e usuários finais, resolvendo questões técnicas e complexas, como dúvidas, através de vários canais com o objetivo de garantir uma experiência excepcional para o ecossistema dos nossos parceiros.
    • Foco do Suporte: Servir como o principal ponto de contato, oferecendo suporte a parceiros e usuários finais através de múltiplos canais como e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.

  • CX Reclame Aqui : Você será responsável por resolver tickets de usuários e parceiros com alto nível de fricção no canal Reclame Aqui. Seu objetivo é manter o selo RA-1000 da marca e elevar a reputação e o valor do Wellhub no mercado.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com casos críticos via e-mail, WhatsApp e telefone, com foco em manter a imagem e reputação do Wellhub.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimento Específico: Conhecimento das métricas, regras e plataforma do Reclame Aqui, além de noções básicas do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC).
  • CX Social Media : Você será encarregado de proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para todos os usuários do Wellhub nas redes sociais e em canais de avaliação, como Instagram, Twitter, Google Play Store e Reddit. O objetivo é garantir um serviço ao cliente extremamente satisfatório e ajudar a criar estratégias focadas no cliente.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar comentários e mensagens em canais como Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Youtube, TikTok e comunidades como Reddit.

    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar a comunicação com os clientes (e-mail, chat, telefone) para garantir sua satisfação, fornecendo soluções completas e precisas.

    • Conhecimentos Necessários: Utilizar o Zendesk para fornecer informações precisas ao cliente e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
